text:
Ibrahim: Quick heads-up — two big personal updates: I accepted the Staff ML Eng role (still pinching myself) and Mina proposed to me last weekend ❤️. Wedding plans for September. Wanted to share the good news with the team! :tada:
Mina: Ibraaargh, so proud!! :sob: Massive congrats on the promotion and ring. We’ll celebrate properly at the next all-hands.
Connor: Wait — promoted AND engaged in the same month? How do you even have time to commit code. :joy: Congrats both!!!
Tess (People Ops): Congrats!!! :tada: We’ll set up a little celebratory card and coordinate a cake/virtual splash. Ibrahim, ping me when you have a preferred date for a team toast and any time off requests.
Ibrahim: Thanks all ❤️. @Tess I’ll DM you about a short PTO block for honeymoon planning, should be ~week in Sept. No parental leave needed here :)
Priya: Yesss congrats!! Drinks at the office rooftop? I’ll bring sparklers. :sparkles:
Connor: Cake poll: croissant cake vs. chocolate fudge vs. lemon tart. Vote with emoji.
Mina: Chocolate fudge for life. :chocolate_bar:
Ibrahim: Lemon tart actually, but I will accept chocolate as a peace offering. :stuck_out_tongue: Thanks everyone, means a lot.
calendar-bot: Event created by Mina: "Team celebration — Ibrahim promo & engagement" on 2026-04-02 4:30pm PT.
Priya: Adding confetti GIF in thread. :confetti_ball:
Connor: GIF received. Also — mandatory ring inspection before invite list finalized. :eyes:
Tess (People Ops): Noted. We’ll draft a short congratulatory note in Slack and set up gift collection channel if folks want to contribute.
Ibrahim: Appreciate it. Back to shipping, but couldn’t not share :)
